Israel Bans Pakistani Pilots, Affecting Air France Flights

Israel has imposed a ban on Pakistani pilots and crew from operating flights to and from the country. This action has led to Air France complying with Israeli requirements, banning Pakistani pilots and crew from its flights to Israel. The ban follows an incident involving flydubai. The move has reportedly caused concern in Muslim countries.
